name: Southern Financial Corporation
summary: Southern Financial Corporation functions as the parent entity for Southern Bank, which delivers a comprehensive suite of financial products and services. Through its subsidiary, the bank provides diverse offerings such as personal and business checking accounts, savings and money market accounts, and certificates of deposit (CDs). Additionally, it extends mortgage solutions and various business lending services, complemented by robust digital banking capabilities. The company, established in 1945, was formerly known as Sardis Bankshares, Inc. until it adopted the name Southern Financial Corporation in April 2021. Its operations are based in Spartanburg, South Carolina.
